listen.title: STAR incident — bắt số phút

unseen.speaker: B
unseen.en: Tell me about an incident, STAR please.

unseen.speaker: A
unseen.en: The situation was a Saturday deploy that broke search.
unseen.vi: Tình huống: deploy thứ Bảy làm hỏng search.

unseen.speaker: A
unseen.en: My task was to restore search without a full rollback if possible.
unseen.vi: Task: khôi phục search, tránh rollback hết nếu được.

unseen.speaker: A
unseen.en: I did a config revert, then isolated the query planner change.
unseen.vi: Mình revert config, rồi isolate thay đổi query planner.

unseen.speaker: A
unseen.en: The result was we recovered in 12 minutes. Traffic came back.
unseen.vi: Kết quả khôi phục 12 phút. Traffic trở lại.

unseen.speaker: A
unseen.en: What I learned is to canary DDL.
unseen.vi: Mình học được là canary DDL.

unseen.speaker: B
unseen.en: 12 minutes from detect or from start of fix?
unseen.vi: 12 phút từ lúc detect hay lúc bắt đầu fix?

unseen.speaker: A
unseen.en: From detect. Fix itself was about six.
unseen.vi: Từ lúc detect. Fix khoảng sáu phút.

Nói việc thật hôm nay: My task was ___

aiPrompt.scenario: A short STAR story about a real incident or deadline of yours.
aiPrompt.system: You are a friendly teammate (or interviewer) at a software company. Speak natural meeting English. Keep each turn to 1–2 short sentences. You MAY use extra workplace English so the learner practices listening. Nudge the learner to use these phrases: The situation was…; My task was…; I did…; The result was…; What I learned…. If they ask you to slow down or repeat, do that. Ask one concrete detail about their real work (ticket, bug, PR, or project). Wait for the learner to reply. Scenario: A short STAR story about a real incident or deadline of yours.
